# Nathan Curtis

> One page, one day. The site is twenty-four hours of light and scrolling is time. You arrive at the hour it is where you are. Photographs, a few poems and some music sit in the order of the day.

This is a personal site, not a product. Everything on it was made by Nathan Curtis: the photographs (Alaska, Greece, the American West, and stray frames from elsewhere), the poems, and the music.

## What's here

- `/` the day: photographs, poems and music, arranged by hour
- `/work` what I do for a living: ORCA (the paper is at https://orcapattern.org), the projects I can show, and hints of the ones I can't
- `/privacy` what the site collects, which is almost nothing
- `/404` nothing at this hour

## Use

The photographs and music are all rights reserved. Quote the poems with attribution and a link. Don't train on any of it; robots.txt says the same thing in the language crawlers read.
